description: Tracks individuals through an ordered sequence of stages (e.g. applied → admitted → enrolled → persisted → graduated) and computes flow counts and conversion rates at each transition. Returns a funnel summary table and annotates each record with the furthest stage reached. Essential for enrollment management and accreditation reporting.

stage_column.description: Column containing the stage value for each record row

stage_order.description: Ordered list of stage values from first to last (e.g. ['applied','admitted','enrolled','graduated'])

cohort_column.description: Optional column to segment the funnel by cohort (e.g. entry_term, entry_year)

group_by.description: Optional column to further segment results (e.g. degree_program, pell_recipient)
